query: 员工申诉机制 员工申诉机制 衡量企业为员工提供的正式申诉渠道的可达性、运作独立性及问题闭环处理能力。重点考察匿名保护、反报复政策、明确的处理时限及高级别的申议/升级机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备独立的匿名申诉渠道（如第三方平台）；有明确的书面“反报复”政策保护申诉人；规定了清晰的处理时限（如 48 小时反馈）及未决事项向上升级（Escalation）至董事会的路径。 • 1分（合格）：建立了内部申诉渠道（如意见箱、HR 邮箱），具备基础的申诉受理流程和保护声明，但缺乏第三方独立性、明确的处理时限或高级别的管理层监督机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式申诉渠道披露，或仅有笼统的“欢迎员工提意见”等非制度化表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的员工（含全职、劳务派遣及主要现场供应商员工），且定期进行员工知晓度培训/测评。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅总部可见而基层厂区难以触达，或未说明知晓度/可用性的覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 员工申诉机制 员工诉说渠道 举报热线 反报复 升级机制 匿名举报 申诉处理时限 结案率 employee grievance mechanism speak-up channel whistleblowing hotline anti-retaliation escalation anonymous reporting grievance handling timeframe 员工正式申诉渠道有哪些（热线、第三方平台、HR邮箱等）？ 是否支持匿名及书面反报复保护？ 是否规定处理时限与升级至高层/董事会路径？ 机制覆盖哪些员工类型？ 是否开展知晓度培训或测评？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '员工申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 员工正式申诉渠道有哪些（热线、第三方平台、HR邮箱等）？ 是否支持匿名及书面反报复保护？ 是否规定处理时限与升级至高层/董事会路径？ 机制覆盖哪些员工类型？ 是否开展知晓度培训或测评？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“欢迎提意见”；仅有客户投诉热线；仅有供应商申诉机制；仅有反歧视政策而无通用申诉渠道；区分：员工申诉机制面向员工可达性与闭环；供应商申诉面向供应商；举报人保护更偏舞弊/合规举报保护；纠正补救是违规后处置流程，不是申诉入口本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In addition, the Group has established various whistle-blowing channels such as official website, official WeChat account, mail, telephone, to enable employee to report any misconduct or wrongdoing. When a report or a complaint is received, the Group will appoint the Internal Audit and Compliance Department to carry out investigation and confirmation on the reported case. results.text: The Group has been using a variety of communication channels to maintain regular communication with staff and to gather more employment feedback. During the Year, 'Grass-roots Gunshot Plan' continues and the Group has collected 33 proposals, 17 of which have been adopted, representing an adoption rate of 52%, and 15 of which have been pushed forward. The 'City Face-to-Face' program is the main source of employee opinions collected under 'Grass-roots Gunshot Plan', initiated by the Process Department of the Group's President's Office. It aims to listen to the voices of frontline employees, help city companies solve core pain points in the process of business development on the one hand, and strengthen the communication and interaction between headquarters and city companies on the other hand, so as to facilitate both sides to reach a consensus on concepts and improve the efficiency of business development.

The Group has been using a variety of communication channels to maintain regular communication with staff and to gather more employment feedback. During the Year, 'Grass-roots Gunshot Plan' continues and the Group has collected 33 proposals, 17 of which have been adopted, representing an adoption rate of 52%, and 15 of which have been pushed forward. The 'City Face-to-Face' program is the main source of employee opinions collected under 'Grass-roots Gunshot Plan', initiated by the Process Department of the Group's President's Office. It aims to listen to the voices of frontline employees, help city companies solve core pain points in the process of business development on the one hand, and strengthen the communication and interaction between headquarters and city companies on the other hand, so as to facilitate both sides to reach a consensus on concepts and improve the efficiency of business development.
